`/work/cam_0697.lean` now compiles with no errors or warnings, and the `sorry` is replaced with a full proof.

The proof goes as follows. For two points `x` and `y` and weights `a`, `b`, take near-optimal pairs `(c1, d1)` and `(c2, d2)` for each point, within any `ε > 0` of the infimum. The combined pair `a•c1 + b•c2` and `a•d1 + b•d2` lies in `C` and `D` by convexity. Its distance for `a•x + b•y` is at most `a` times the first distance plus `b` times the second, by the triangle inequality. The infimum at the combined point is therefore at most `a•f x + b•f y + ε`, and letting `ε` go to 0 gives convexity.
